_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_sph#12. SPH_TIMESTEP_LINES=0 is the assertion, counted across THREE decks at 10x, 50x and 200x the upstream time step: not one line matching cfl, courant, critical time step or stable time step at any size. At 10x and 50x the time loop runs to the end, the result-test manager is reached, nothing aborts in the loop, and only the verdicts move. At 200x the first complaint is the BINNING strategy, and BIN_ABORT_MENTIONS_THE_STEP=no records that it names neither the step nor CFL. The last probe is the contrast that makes the absence legible rather than merely asserted: the SAME particle engine, run in DEM mode at 20x, DOES print a critical-step warning. Note the deliberate avoidance of 'processor 0 finished normally' as a completion token -- a failing result test aborts through MPI and never prints it, which would make a healthy-but-wrong run look like a crash. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 removes the pathology from every probe deck; unmutated the fixture PASSES, mutated it FAILS. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 bash cmd.sh`.
